description:
Welcome to Fabian Electrical Services Inc – your go-to source for professional electrical tips, real-world installations, and expert insights from the jobsite.

Based in Toronto, Canada, we specialize in everything from panel upgrades, pot light installations, and grounding & bonding to smart lighting, troubleshooting, and code-compliant wiring.

Whether you’re a homeowner, DIY enthusiast, or licensed electrician, you’ll find value in our clear walkthroughs, tool reviews, and behind-the-scenes of live projects.

⚡ New videos weekly: Shorts, tutorials, upgrades, and must-know electrical code tips.

👉 Subscribe and join the community: Real work. Real installs. Real results.

⚠️ Disclaimer: All content is for educational purposes only. Follow the Canadian Electrical Code (OESC 2024), NEC, and local rules. Hire a licensed electrician. Fabian Electrical is not liable for misuse.

Proudly serving GTA & beyond | Licensed & Insured | #ElectricianLife
